definitions: Relating to or characteristic of the American psychologist Carl Rogers or his theories, especially those concerning client-centred therapy.
Pertaining to the theories and methods of Carl Rogers, emphasizing empathy, unconditional positive regard, and congruence in therapeutic relationships.
examples: Rogerian therapy focuses on the client's self-actualization.
The counsellor adopted a Rogerian approach.
She studied Rogerian principles in her psychology course.
